List of Eligible Candidates for the post of Jr Clerk (Updated on 05/06/2025)
Tuesday, 03 June 2025
2452 Hits
Applications received for the post of
Junior Clerk
have been scrutinized. Based on the recommendations of the Scrutiny Committee, the eligible candidates list has been displayed on the website and notice board. Rest of the candidates are ineligible as per the criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
Revised Jr. Clerk Eligibility List
If any applicant is not satisfied, they may submit a written representation along with supporting documents. Representations without valid supporting documents will not be entertained.
Deadline for Representation Submission:
Please contact the
Medical Superintendent’s Office (Personnel Section)
on or before
14th June 2025, by 5:00 PM
.
Note:
No requests will be entertained after the specified deadline.
Interview and Skill Test Details
Candidates who qualify the
Written Examination
will be shortlisted for the Skill Test and those who will qualified
skill test
will be called for
Interview on the same day
.
The list of shortlisted candidates will be displayed on the
Notice Board of Kasturba Hospital, Sewagram
& Website.
Written Examination & Interview & Skill Test Schedule:
Written Examination Date   : -        17/06/2025 Time        : -        10. AM :-
Central Examination Hall, Kasturba Hospital, Sewagram
Skill Test & Interview Date : -        26/06/2025 Time        : -        10. AM : -              Kasturba Hospital, Sewagram
Medical Superintendent
Kasturba Hospital, Sewagram
Swachhata Pakhwada - 2025
